newsitem.title: USA: Zycad Q1 shr loss $0.22 vs loss $0.25.
newsitem.headline: Zycad Q1 shr loss $0.22 vs loss $0.25.

text.p: Zycad Corp Thursday reported a first quarter loss of $5.6 million or $0.22 a share on revenues of $4.1 million.
In the comparable period ended March 31, 1996, revenues were $6,978,000 and the company reported a loss of $5.0 or $0.25 a share.

In a statement, the company said revenues were adversely affected by the sale of the LightSpeed product line to IKOS Systems Inc and a general slow down in capital purchases as evidenced by the performance of other Electronic Design Automation companies during the first quarter.
Zycad also said it has received formal notification from the Nasdaq Qualification Panel that it must meet certain net worth requirements by May 15.

The company said it believes it does have sufficient net tangible assets with the filing of its most recent 8-K (May 15, 1997) and that the Company's securities will continue to be listed on the Nasdaq National Markets with no change.
Further, the company announced the completion of the sale of its 22 percent holdings in Quality Systems and Software Inc for $3,500,000.
